circuits.name: Doon, Mussoorie and Tehri
circuits.blurb: Up from the Doon valley to Mussoorie's ridge, along the Dhanaulti deodars to Chamba and the Tehri lake, and down to Rishikesh.

circuits.name: The prayags to Badrinath
circuits.blurb: Up the Alaknanda by its confluences: Devprayag, Rudraprayag, Karnaprayag, Nandprayag and Vishnuprayag below Joshimath, to Badrinath.

circuits.name: Kedar valley and Tungnath
circuits.blurb: To Gaurikund, where the Kedarnath trail starts, then over the Chopta meadows below Tungnath to Gopeshwar.

circuits.name: Yamunotri and Gangotri
circuits.blurb: Over Mussoorie to the Yamuna valley and the Yamunotri trail, then across to Uttarkashi and up the Bhagirathi past Harsil to Gangotri.

circuits.name: The Pauri ridge
circuits.blurb: From Kotdwar up to the cantonment at Lansdowne, along the oak ridges to Pauri, down to Srinagar and by Devprayag to Rishikesh.

circuits.name: Jaunsar-Bawar and the Tons
circuits.blurb: Up from Vikasnagar to Chakrata's cantonment, through the Jaunsari villages to Purola, and back by the Yamuna valley and Mussoorie.
